title: platform-standup-2026-04-08
content:
Attendees: Asha, Miguel, Lina, Omar, Priya (remote)

Quick summary:
- Focused on control-plane release (v1.12) today: auth token migration + new routing policy flags.
- Quotas enforcement bug (edge case with burst windows) still in triage — impacting a small % of Dedicated customers.
- Routing: started gradual rollout of weighted routing by region (canary at 5%). Initial metrics look OK.

Yesterday:
- Miguel: deployed control-plane 1.12 to staging, validated KV-store schema migration; found intermittent failures on token refresh path. Root cause: race between token-rotator and cache priming. Added short lock around rotate. Tests passing in staging.
- Lina: working on routing policy config UI; pushed PR for backend validation (repo/control-plane#278). Needs review from Platform API team.
- Omar: investigated quotas bug, captured repro steps and a synthetic load test that reproduces the burst mis-accounting. Filed JIRA PLAT-482 with heatmap and timeline.
- Asha: smoke-tested canary for new routing; collected latency p50/p95 for requests routed to new variant and baseline. p95 +~12ms — within SLO but higher than ideal.

Today:
- Miguel: finish token migration rollback plan for case when rotation lock causes perf regressions; aim to get fallback in by EOD.
- Lina: address API review comments, add feature flag for enabling region weights per-tenant; coordinate with Console team for toggles.
- Omar: patch quotas accounting logic; add additional unit tests and a long-running integration test against billing-sandbox.
- Asha: monitor canary rollout (5% -> 10% if stable). Run smoke suites against auth edge cases.

Blockers / Risks:
- Token rotation race: if lock causes contention under high throughput it could add tail latency; need perf test under realistic load (work with SRE).
- Quotas fix needs careful verification — incorrect billing could be customer-impacting. Hold off wide rollout until integration tests pass and we have signoff from finance.
- Console toggle for routing weights depends on frontend change; coordinate on scheduling so we don't open feature without UI.

Action items:
- Miguel: add fallback toggle + perf test by 2026-04-08 17:00 (assigned). Linked PR when ready.
- Lina: update backend PR with feature-flag gating and ping console-team for sync (ETA 2026-04-09).
- Omar: land quotas patch behind feature flag and run billing-sandbox integration (ETA 2026-04-09).
- Asha: escalate to SRE for perf run and keep CS updated on potential billing rollouts.

Notes / Misc:
- Observability: Dashboard for control-plane token refresh failures created (link in Confluence). We'll add an alert if token refresh error rate > 0.5% over 5m.
- Oncall: Priya is primary this week; Pager duty rotations updated. Priya to follow up on a persistent spike in 5xxs seen yesterday around 03:40 UTC (suspected external load).
- Suggest adding a postmortem template for quota incidents to speed up RCA in future.

References:
- JIRA PLAT-482 (quotas burst mis-accounting)
- PR repo/control-plane#278 (routing validation)
- Confluence: control-plane-rollout notes

Notes to self: keep standup short tomorrow, call out any customer impact immediately. If quotas fix looks risky, prepare rollback plan to revert to per-tenant conservative quota window.
